The paper's primary contribution is characterization of dissimilar metal weld joints, focusing on the welding process, metallurgical properties, and mechanical behavior (fracture toughness) of welded materials in a pressure vessel application—a core manufacturing and joining engineering problem.

This review focuses on microwave-assisted joining techniques for metals (similar and dissimilar), characterization of joined specimens, and critical process parameters—a materials joining and manufacturing process that falls squarely within Manufacturing & Industry 4.0 rather than materials discovery.

The paper presents laser-assisted microhole fabrication in polymer substrates using fiber laser machining with design of experiments and process optimization—a core precision manufacturing and microfabrication technique.

The paper surveys VR applications for COVID-19 pandemic response, including telemedicine, remote patient monitoring, and surveillance systems—a healthcare technology application focused on clinical practice and disease management rather than VR hardware/software development or communication infrastructure.

The paper investigates soliton-like structures and nonlinear wave phenomena in dusty plasma using molecular dynamics, which falls under plasma-wave physics and nonlinear electromagnetic-plasma interactions for wave generation and propagation.

The paper designs and develops a medical device (stent implant) with engineered auxetic structure for clinical vascular application, demonstrating manufacturing and mechanical validation for therapeutic use in vessel patency maintenance.

The paper studies soil-geosynthetic interactions, reinforcement techniques, and foundation performance of back-to-back reinforced earth walls supporting railway infrastructure through FEA and stability analysis—core geotechnical engineering research for infrastructure systems.

The paper develops molecular diagnostic methods (mutation analysis and RFLP) for identifying asymptomatic Wilson disease patients and carrier status in families, which is a clinical diagnostic application for disease detection and family screening.

Paper addresses physical layer impairments, signal quality metrics (SNR), and wavelength assignment in optical WDM networks, which are core signal processing and physical layer communication challenges; routing and resource allocation in optical networks with emphasis on signal integrity and channel performance.
